answer: To enter scoring, an agent posts a refundable bond into a shared garden escrow at the dawn of its first epoch, sized to two epochs of expected rewards and locked for three. Peers in the local grove attest only after verifying the bond is unique to one key and still locked; if two identities share a funder or recycle a withdrawn bond, the grove slashes both stakes and blacklists the cluster for ten epochs. A sybil swarm therefore pays a full multi-epoch bond per fake, while honest agents recover the stake after a clean hold.
